1bcu6gh.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, vehicle H passes first.

uiorlv.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, the vehicles must pass in the order: H, A, F, L.

26fapb.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, the vehicles must pass in the order: A, F, L, H.

u1y1k6.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, vehicle F must pass first.

1huv6e4.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, vehicle H must wait for vehicle L to pass.

1kmr7bu.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, vehicle H must wait for vehicle F to pass.
1kmr7bu.why: H has no duty to give way and goes first, before F, which must also wait for A.

1km5j8v.q: According to the right-of-way rules at the intersection shown, vehicle A must wait for vehicle F to pass.
1km5j8v.why: It is F that has A on its right and must yield to it. A only yields to H.

1ctnwka.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle N is the last to finish crossing the intersection.

10jpqjv.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N must give way to vehicle A.

16ikro3.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N has priority over vehicle R.
16ikro3.why: N comes from R's right, so it has priority over R.

1yg1zx6.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N can complete its left turn after vehicles R and A have passed.

2bbuj.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N, after moving to the centre of the intersection, must wait for vehicles R and A to pass.

1lwk0d3.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R must give way to vehicle N.
1lwk0d3.why: N comes from R's right, so R must give way to it.

hcgc4b.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R has priority over vehicle A.
hcgc4b.why: R comes from A's right, so it has priority over A.

1tm72ip.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R crosses the intersection after vehicle N has stopped in the centre of the intersection.

1jwvhun.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R passes before vehicle A.
1jwvhun.why: R comes from A's right, so it has priority over A.

21qa7f.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R is the first to finish crossing.
21qa7f.why: R has priority over A and passes once N has moved to the centre. It finishes crossing first, before A and N.

a0x8z3.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N crosses first.
a0x8z3.why: N enters the centre but, turning left, must yield to A and completes its manoeuvre last.

159izce.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N must give way to vehicle R.
159izce.why: R comes from N's left and must yield to N, which is on its right. N does not have to yield to R.

1b8e0gm.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N has priority over vehicle A.

l57hqz.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N passes after vehicle R has gone but before vehicle A passes.

ba8mxx.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle N is the last to enter the intersection.

1iuodqe.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R must give way to vehicle A.

1lviq0s.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R passes last.

17fcdwd.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R passes after vehicle A has gone.

f0ta45.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle R enters the intersection and stops in the centre.

1s47qa5.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A must give way to the tram and to vehicle B.

11scs23.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A has priority over vehicle C.

3339b7.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the order: T and B, A, C.

1vlp34e.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles T and B can pass at the same time.

1s91ng.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle C passes last.

yhstk.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles T and C pass at the same time.

et9x9k.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the order: T, B, C, A.
et9x9k.why: C has A on its right and must yield to it, so A passes before C. The correct order is T and B, A, C.

1lkf57e.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A passes last.
1lkf57e.why: A passes after the tram and B but before C, which must give way to it.

869etx.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicles T, B and C pass at the same time.

b5nth3.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle B must give way to vehicle A.

17id34j.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D passes first.

ho8qyt.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A passes last.

15iiy34.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A must give way to vehicles E and S.

pqj3d7.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, before entering the intersection, the driver of vehicle A must wait for vehicles D, E and S to pass, in that order.

1c3m45a.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D passes third.

cxk4of.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D is obliged to give way to all vehicles.

1kb7942.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle D is obliged to give way to vehicle E, which continues straight ahead.

1x5c1kg.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A has a free right-hand side.

1kdhdyr.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A passes at the same time as vehicle D.

lrcgj2.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the driver of vehicle A passes after vehicles E and S, but before vehicle D.

5zk2rk.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle T passes last.

2dyvvt.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle R passes first.

nrhkvl.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle A must wait for vehicle R to pass.

buxrs1.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle T must wait for vehicles R and A to pass.

1losmoy.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, vehicle T passes before vehicle R.

v0jnts.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the order: R, T, A.

1slhkme.q: In the intersection shown in the figure, the vehicles pass in the order: T, A, R.

g3lawb.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle B must give way to vehicle S.

1jsmvv7.q: In the intersection shown, the order in which the vehicles pass is: S, B, L, D.

j1t8o7.q: In the intersection shown, the order in which the vehicles pass is: S, B, then D and L at the same time.

1n7vt1k.q: In the intersection shown, the order in which the vehicles pass is: F, R, D.

nybwag.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle T passes last.

4p1j3e.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle D passes before vehicle B.

1vztkxb.q: In the intersection shown, the order in which the vehicles pass is: N, A, R.

1knh5da.q: In the intersection shown, vehicles A and R must stop if necessary.

gs3xms.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle A can pass before vehicle R, but after vehicle N.

17opjvp.q: In the intersection shown, the order in which the vehicles pass is: A, N, R.

7b4fji.q: In the intersection shown, the order of precedence of the vehicles is: N, R, A

1a1c00h.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle T goes first

148be0n.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles go in the following order: T, P, M

1lsl655.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle M goes last

pkx8tu.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle M has priority because it is in public service

188qlwt.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles go in the following order: T, M, P

llhr6m.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle T may go first, provided that vehicle M is not performing a scheduled public service

1xfb4zz.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle R goes first

8iz3np.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles go in the following order: R, D, A

fymtnw.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle D goes before vehicle R

1u8dj0v.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles go in the following order: D, A, R

bre579.q: In the intersection shown, vehicles A and R go at the same time

1auc8ua.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicle T goes first
1auc8ua.why: T is a tram and always has priority over other vehicles, so it goes first.

14gqab9.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicle A goes right after vehicle T

1dx1ot5.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicle S must wait for vehicles T and A to pass

1jerwfi.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, the vehicles must go in the following order: T, A, S

3iw1rr.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicle A goes first

1q18n0k.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, the vehicles must go in the following order: A, T, S

1fjgkzl.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicle S goes after vehicle T, but before vehicle A

xsjbss.q: Having to cross the intersection shown, vehicles A and S go at the same time after vehicle T has passed

q3dqrh.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle B must wait for vehicle P to pass

1ov0li6.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle P goes first

14j0a9r.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown the vehicles go in the order: P, B, C

yynnwo.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle C has its right side occupied

1lxf1od.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle B goes last

b0k9m9.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown the vehicles go in the order: P, C, B

1unzgca.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicles P and C go at the same time

gldasj.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle P enters the intersection first but must stop at the centre of it

1s79ihs.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle B goes first

147wf94.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles go in the following order: B, T, S

yfb4q.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle S goes last

icxt90.q: In the intersection shown, vehicles B and S go at the same time

9liauj.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle A goes after vehicle R

1ixbbnl.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle C does not have to give way to any vehicle

1u4h3ym.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicles R and C go at the same time

1qdwdov.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown the vehicles go in the following order: R, C, A

1tcz3.q: According to the right-of-way rules, in the intersection shown vehicle R must wait for vehicles C and A to pass

1py0dd.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle H does not have to give way to any vehicle

57p8lz.q: In the intersection shown, vehicle D must wait for vehicle B to pass

1r0w7im.q: In the intersection shown, the vehicles clear the intersection in the following order: H, B, D

4lh59n.q: Arriving at the intersection shown, vehicle P may go first

71j53.q: Arriving at the intersection shown, vehicle D must give way to vehicle P

a2a01p.q: Arriving at the intersection shown, the vehicles must go in the following order: P, D, L, B
